//: Root Directory for this project is apps/backend, so the commands step up to the workspace root: npm workspaces must install from there, and the shared packages must be built before the backend can compile against them. `prisma generate` must run inside the build — the client is generated code, not a checked-in artifact, and the function bundle needs it present.
buildCommand: cd ../.. && npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate -w @orbit/backend && npm run build -w @orbit/backend

api/index.ts.//: Reports assemble a PDF or spreadsheet in-request and a large sync push writes many rows in one transaction; the 10s default cuts both off. 60s is the Hobby ceiling.

crons.//: Replaces the 6-hourly setInterval in src/server.ts. Daily is the Hobby minimum; retention is measured in days, so the same rows are pruned. 03:17 rather than 03:00 to avoid the top-of-hour scheduling crowd.

//rewrites: Every request reaches the Express app, which owns its own routing (/health, /metrics, and the API_PREFIX tree). The cron path is excluded so it keeps hitting the dedicated function rather than falling through to Express, which has no route for it.

headers.//: The API is called cross-origin by the console and the mobile app, so CORS is handled in Express against an allowlist. These are the headers that must hold regardless of route.
